items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: God, it almost came to me. I see him just as plain as day. He did the string arrangements.

ctx.x: No, I’m not seeing it on there. The only Bill on here is Billy Cobham. I know he didn’t do it.
